quirks.summary: The server sends only its leaf certificate, without the Sectigo intermediate, so clients that do not fetch missing intermediates fail certificate verification.
quirks.detail: Python requests with its bundled CA file failed with CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED on every call. curl on Windows (Schannel) and Python using the operating-system trust store both connected normally, because they fetch the missing intermediate.
quirks.workaround: Use a client that uses the OS trust store or fetches intermediates, or supply the intermediate. Do not disable certificate verification.

quirks.summary: Search-result metaInfo fields are separated by U+00B7, not '|'.
quirks.workaround: Split on U+00B7, or take the reference up to the first whitespace.

pacing.note: Five requests at 5 s spacing on 2026-09-26 with no 429 or challenge.

robots.note: robots.txt is 'User-agent: *' with 'Disallow: /', so the whole host is disallowed to automated clients.
